name: Metabase
author: metabase
description: Self-hosted BI: dashboards and SQL over databases already on this box. OSS image v0.63.17.3 plus Postgres, loopback-only behind Serve on :8104 because forgejo already owns Metabase's upstream :3000. First admin is seeded from .env via POST /api/setup. Anonymous usage tracking is off. Health-check /api/health, never / — the UI is a SPA.

control._comment: Stop order: the app first, then the database it talks to. Start is the reverse.
